title: Paul McCartney live: Earls Court Exhibition Centre, London | 2003
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Earls Court Exhibition Centre in London, England, on 18 April 2003.

It was the 11th date of the Back In The World Tour, which lasted for 33 dates between March and June 2003, and the first of four non-consecutive nights at Earls Court.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at Earls Court on 11, 14, and 15 September 1993, as part of the New World Tour. He returned there on 20 February 2008 for the Brit Awards.
